# cursor-rules

> Version-aware, security-first coding rules and Agent Skills for AI coding agents, maintained by Phaedra Solutions under the MIT license. One Markdown source builds Cursor project rules (`.cursor/rules/*.mdc`), `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and Agent Skills (`SKILL.md`) for Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot and Gemini CLI.

Each stack rule first reads the installed framework version from the lockfile, then applies current conventions, security controls mapped to OWASP Top 10:2025 and the CWE Top 25, a dated known-vulnerabilities table with minimum safe versions, and the exact lint, typecheck, test and audit commands to run. Below a rule's supported range, the agent follows a `legacy/` rule and `core/legacy-mode`: minimal changes, end-of-life status, compensating controls and a migration skill.

Install from a clone with Node.js 22+ and no dependencies: `node scripts/install.mjs --preset <name> --tool cursor,agents,claude --dest <project> --dry-run`, then run it again without `--dry-run`. Archives for each tool, with `SHA256SUMS`, are attached to every GitHub Release.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/master/README.md): what it is, how it works, quick start, presets, the full generated catalog of rules and skills with version ranges, security and FAQ
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/master/CONTRIBUTING.md): the rule and skill templates, frontmatter fields, sourcing rules and review checklist
- [CHANGELOG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/master/CHANGELOG.md): what changed in each release
- [Decisions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/master/docs/decisions.md): architecture decisions (multi-tool build, Project CodeGuard, license, overlays, evals, distribution)
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/master/SECURITY.md): how to report unsafe rule content or hidden-Unicode tampering privately

## Core rules (always on)

- [core/behavior](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/master/rules/core/behavior.md): scoped changes, small steps, follow existing patterns, state the rule and version being applied
- [core/security-baseline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/master/rules/core/security-baseline.md): secure coding grouped by OWASP Top 10:2025 with CWE Top 25 IDs
- [core/supply-chain](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/master/rules/core/supply-chain.md): no invented packages, lockfiles and frozen installs, release-age cooldowns, install scripts, pinned CI actions
- [core/agent-safety](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/master/rules/core/agent-safety.md): prompt injection, secrets, confirmation before risky commands, MCP server allowlists
- [core/legacy-mode](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/master/rules/core/legacy-mode.md): how to work on versions below a rule's range or past end of life

## Security skills

- [security-audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/master/skills/security-audit/SKILL.md): audit dependencies, code, secrets, containers and CI config, and write security-report.md
- [dependency-vet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/master/skills/dependency-vet/SKILL.md): check a package for existence, typosquats, malware, age and install scripts before adding it
- [cve-check](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/master/skills/cve-check/SKILL.md): look up package@version in OSV, the GitHub Advisory Database, vendor pages, CISA KEV and EPSS
- [secrets-scan](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/master/skills/secrets-scan/SKILL.md): gitleaks scans and revoke-first rotation
- [threat-model-lite](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/master/skills/threat-model-lite/SKILL.md): a 10-minute STRIDE pass for a new feature
- [incident-supply-chain](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/master/skills/incident-supply-chain/SKILL.md): response steps for a compromised dependency, GitHub Action or developer tool

## Optional

- [Rules folder](https://github.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/tree/master/rules): every stack rule by category (languages, frontend, backend, data, mobile, testing, devops, ai, cms-commerce, legacy)
- [Skills folder](https://github.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/tree/master/skills): upgrade and migration skills (Next.js, Angular, React Native, NestJS, Node.js, Django, Laravel, Spring Boot, .NET, AngularJS, CRA to Vite, Vue 2, Struts, Xamarin, Cordova, ingress-nginx and more)
- [Presets](https://github.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/tree/master/presets): bundles of rules and skills per kind of project
- [Consumer CI templates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Phaedra-Solutions/cursor-rules/master/templates/ci/README.md): OSV-Scanner, Semgrep, gitleaks and zizmor workflows to copy into a project
